actors.name: Giorgia Meloni
actors.blurb: Meloni is currently at the center of a diplomatic spat with former U.S. President Donald Trump, who has publicly criticized her on social media. The dispute escalated after Trump claimed Meloni sought his friendship to boost her declining popularity, leading to a strong rebuttal from Meloni emphasizing Italy's sovereignty and her commitment to national interests. This feud has dominated headlines, overshadowing other international events and straining Italy-U.S. relations.
